title: Nicolas Raince to Montmorency, Rome, 13 May and 20 Nov 1526, BnF fr. 2984 pp. 29-31 and p. 105

steps.what: Tomokiyo's keys, DECODE records, Mignet 1886 and Bourrilly 1901 located; unread residue isolated to pp. 29-31 and p. 105.
Tomokiyo's key table read by eye; l, m, n shifted one column.
Blind cluster-to-letter solver in session 1 collapses to a degenerate map.
Key re-measured programmatically off the image; control line resolves glyph for glyph.
Shape-constrained hill-climb over 70/140 clusters with a 6-gram LM gives draft5, about 86 % of letters right.
86 of 106 lines read glyph by glyph against numbered-token images; 20 lines left with a machine decode only.

outcome.method_basis: Tomokiyo's 1526 key for the Raince letters of fr. 2984 (cryptiana francis.htm, 2020) was re-measured off his key image and applied to a transcription of the unread 13 May and 20 Nov 1526 passages.
outcome.fraction_read_source: trans/reading.txt: segmented tokens of the 106 residue lines (5,210); resolved characters on the 86 H lines count read (3,414), ? on H lines and all 20 M (machine) lines count unread.
outcome.notes: 86 of about 106 lines hand-read (reading.txt marks H/M lines, not the H/C/M/I grades). Limit is microfilm resolution and segmentation. fraction_coherent 0.62: letters in words kept as sense in trans/reading_edited.txt (3,233, excluding ..., [ ] supplied letters and (?) words) over the 5,210 segmented tokens; the key is settled, the loss is microfilm transcription.

gaps.item: 13 May 1526 letter, pp. 29-31 (96 lines): residual letter errors and ~20 machine-only lines
gaps.detail: B/W Gallica microfilm; LOO classifier accuracy saturates at 0.868 as hand labels are added, the e/r, t/l/d, s/u/a confusions are resolution-bound; better photographs of pp. 29-31 needed

gaps.item: 20 Nov 1526 letter, lower 21-28 lines of p. 105
gaps.detail: same microfilm limit; only line 4 verified glyph by glyph

gaps.item: one-glyph word sign, bold stem with two crossbars, p. 30 line 1
gaps.detail: matches nothing in Tomokiyo's table; single occurrence

prior.where: Key published by Tomokiyo 2020 without plaintext; partial glosses on the leaves; other letters of the volume read by Mignet 1886 and Bourrilly 1901

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
